name: internallyProjective_iff_tensor_condition
statement: LightCondMod R) : InternallyProjective P ↔ ∀ {A B : LightCondMod R} (e : A ⟶ B) [Epi e], (∀ (S : LightProfinite) (g : P ⊗ (free R).obj S.toCondensed ⟶ B), ∃ (S' : LightProfinite) (π : S' ⟶ S) (_ : Function.Surjective π) (g' : P ⊗ (free R).obj S'.toCondensed ⟶ A), (P ◁ ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free R).map π)) ≫ g = g' ≫ e)
